messages.text: Heads up: inventory reservations now expire after 15 minutes. If a checkout hangs, stock frees itself — no more manual releases.
Coupon math must stay integer: subtotal_cents * percent // 100. A float here re-introduces the rounding bug from PAY-063.
OutOfStock during checkout is expected behaviour, not an error to swallow — it's the guard that stops overselling (INV-150).
Order states are fixed: pending -> paid -> fulfilled -> shipped -> delivered (plus cancelled/refunded). transition() rejects anything else.
Reminder: order_items snapshot the unit price at purchase time. Never join to the live catalog price for an old order.
